scripts.build:prod: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=production --target=website --quiet && bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs check --profile=production --target=website --quiet && astro build
scripts.eslint: eslint src --no-cache --fix --max-warnings 0 --fix-type problem,suggestion,layout && echo '✅ ESLint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.eslint:check: eslint src --no-cache --max-warnings 0 && echo '✅ ESLint: 检查通过'
scripts.stylelint: stylelint "src/**/*.vue" --no-cache --fix && echo '✅ Stylelint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name yiveno-website --branch main --commit-dirty=true
